content: This section includes three subsections. The first subsection concerns Thai sentence segmentation, which is the main focus of this work. The task of English punctuation restoration, which is similar to our main task, is described in the second subsection. The last subsection describes the original Cross-View Training initially proposed in BIBREF20 .
